title: Unit Event — The Song of a Canary in Crisis — Episode5 To Close The Gap

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis
meta.Event Outline: As the 30th Anniversary Show approaches, Nene is hard at work preparing for her role as the Cowardly Canary. However, during a rehearsal, the director criticizes not her acting, but her singing...

rows.Line: Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you doing here, Seiryuin...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Oh, did you think that you're the only one who practices on their own outside of our regular times?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No...
I never thought that. Honest.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's clear that you've been working quite hard lately, but I'd rather not see you do anything that's going to affect your performance during the show.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
I mean, those bags under your eyes...
Have you not been sleeping lately?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, they're just...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I know you don't want to show weakness in front of the others, but you shouldn't hesitate to ask for help.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Since we're all in this show together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I, in particular, have first-rate acting skills while also being an expert singer. But you already know that...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Or...
Do you believe that I wouldn't give sufficient advice?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, I just...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Yeah, wow...
The perfect person to ask was right under my nose this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I had to have known that...
I mean, this was my shortcut all along. And yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A part of me kept hesitating. Was I feeling too proud...?)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I understand how hard it must be for you to ask me for advice.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: After all, we seem to be well on our way to becoming rivals.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You still see me as your rival...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
No, that's not... What I meant...
I didn't mean it that other time either...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That other time...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You've proven that you may be worthy of being our rivals. But you'll need to maintain this standard for your next show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Oh, right. That's what she meant...
She didn't specifically say that we're rivals.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I just convinced myself that we were somewhere along the way...)

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: However, you certainly have what it takes to compete against me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have what it takes...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes. The difference between you and me is experience. Also, how broad our vision is...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Minus those factors, then you would...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Likely be on the same level as me.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I agree with what the director said about you during practice. The way you sing does stick out.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Largely because of this habit of yours.
To elaborate...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It's something unique to those who've been acting since they were children.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's unique to people like me...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I thought acting since when I was little would give me a big advantage...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How did you...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: An old habit like this is going to prove challenging to break. I suspect that it will take quite a bit of time...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I could give you some advice regarding that...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
However...
The perfect teacher for this just happens to be in town.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The perfect teacher...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes, and I believe you two have already met.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: You should take this opportunity to speak with her.
A few days later
Cafe

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ten minutes until we're supposed to meet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I never thought I'd get to see her again. There's still ten minutes, but my heart's already racing at full speed...)

Oh, you're already here!
I didn't keep you waiting, did I?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
It's so nice to see you again, Nene!
How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-It's very nice to see you again as well...
Also, thank you for meeting with me today...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure.
I just happened to have some free time on my hands after coming home.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Oh, why don't we order some drinks first?
My friend actually runs this little shop. I really recommend the hot chocolate if you'd be willing to try it. What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, then... Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Two hot chocolates, please...
A nice helping of milk with mine as always.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ms. Kazamatsuri seems well.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(And she remembered who I am...
Even though we only talked for a little bit that time. This is so amazing.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, would you mind if I asked what brings you back to Japan? I thought you were living in the United States now...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Oh, a friend of mine is putting on a show over here and invited me to come see it.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
His name is Seiichi Amami...
I'm sure you've heard of him, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, I have.
He's currently performing at Tokyo Century Hall. I actually went to see his show just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Oh, you did?!
As much as I'd like to tell Seiichi what you thought...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: We have quite an important matter to discuss today, yes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You don't get many chances in life to ask for advice from a star like Ms. Kazamatsuri. No, almost never do...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to tell her everything and absorb all the advice that she gives me...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You're having trouble seeing your show's big picture...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes, and I've been looking into what this habit of mine is. Unfortunately, I haven't been able to find a clear answer...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
I see.
But we all have habits. Some have nothing to do with singing and are a vital part of who you are.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: However, to start...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Would you mind singing for me?
I'd like to hear where you're at right now, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-Here?
But we're in a cafe... Won't we be bothering the other customers...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Oh, this place hosts concerts and stuff all the time, so don't worry. See that stage over there?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: It may startle a few people, but it could also act as a fun surprise, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A... A fun surprise...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Singing here means having all these people in the cafe hear a really rough version of my songs...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, stop...
I can't be scared of something like that.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I made the decision to do everything I can. So...!)

rows.Speaker: Cafe Customers
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Was there a show scheduled today?

rows.Speaker: Cafe Customers
rows.Line: This sounds like a number from a musical.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(My voice sounds shaky...
This isn't how I sound when I'm practicing by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is so embarrassing. I really wanna run...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No, don't run...
That won't solve anything...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Forget about feeling embarrassed.
I have to accept where I'm currently at as a singer...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to sing and hear what she thinks...! I want our show to succeed...!)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Thank you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for listening...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... How did I do?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I really doubt she was all that impressed. I mean, Ms. Kazamatsuri's an international performer, and I'm so far behind everyone from the Phoenix Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I'm ready to take on whatever she says...
I wanna know exactly where I am as a singer right now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm willing to accept anything that comes my way. I want to move forward...)

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You've become such a good singer.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: During your other show, the way you really let your emotions flow as you sang while setting aside all the technical stuff really left an impression on me.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But from what I just heard, you've learned to balance those things out rather nicely.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
You've improved so much.
You must've been working very hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, um... Sorry, I just...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, stop...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (You know your singing leaves a lot to be desired. You know that you have to work even harder. So...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Now's not the time to feel delighted...
This isn't why you're here right now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I know I have to do more.
I know I have to practice even harder...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
And I only realized that recently...
Just the other day actually.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Please, tell me anything that comes to mind.
Even the smallest piece of advice will do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: If this goes on and I end up putting on a shoddy performance, I'll never forgive myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Please, I beg of you...
Because I...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to become a world-class musical actress...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: That means we're going to be rivals in the future, right, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: With that in mind, I'm only going to help you out this one time.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: For the duration of my stay, Nene, I'm going to cram absolutely everything I have to offer into your head!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you very much!
